author: Kiona - Chicago, IL
body: As a pediatrician, I felt confident in my baby knowledge. But navigating the world of baby gear was an entirely different challenge (and as a single mom and busy working professional, one I didn’t have much time to tackle). Emilie was a life-saver in terms of helping me figure out what was essential, what was a luxury, and what I could skip altogether. She tailored every recommendation to my lifestyle and really took the time to understand what was important to me. Her meticulous, thoughtful approach brought clarity and calm to an otherwise overwhelming process. Even before my son arrived, Emilie ensured our home was peaceful, functional, and fully prepared—down to the smallest detail. Her support went far beyond logistics; it made the early days of motherhood more grounded, intentional, and deeply meaningful. Her expertise and care were truly invaluable.
